events.title: NEW DEMO HOTFIX IS LIVE!
events.summary: We’ve been listening to your feedback! This hotfix introduces several quality-of-life improvements and UX tweaks to make your time in Bad House smoother and more enjoyable. Here’s what’s new:Added Autosort to inventory and storageShift + Click now allows you to quickly transfer items between your inventory, storage and shops.Ctrl + Click to quickly drop items from your inventoryAdded hotkeys to quick access to menus:S – Open the skills windowTab – Open the inventoryESC now closes open UI windows

events.title: New to Market! Bad House Short-Term Rentals Available Now with our new DEMO!
events.summary: After market-wide interest (and the previous tenant’s sudden disappearance), we’re offering prospective tenants a first-look at Bad House with our short-term rental demo available NOW on Steam.This dungeon crawler auto-battler is brought to market by designer Andrew Morrish. Take a look at this expansive abode, featuring various period features, including the first four floors of a surprisingly spacious basement (n.b.
